item: The Merge shows the unreadable repair-record warning (this instance, JSON, YAML and bundle uploads); a repaired row is no longer made measured by a later IMPORTED attempt (diagnostics rank 14, the post-merge check of #1299)
status: SHIPPED (field effect at the next Merge)
key_paths: src/api/diagnostics/qualification_merge.py; src/catalog/qualification_merge.py; src/static/app-ai-tools.js; src/catalog/qualification_export.py; src/catalog/qualification_integrity.py; docs/product/RELEASE_0.4_GATE.md; tests/test_qualification_merge_action.py; tests/test_curated_catalog_stamp.py
summary: The Merge fed this instance in as verdict rows only, so the rows an unreadable boot-repair run withdrew counted as measured corroboration with nothing said. The report's inputs now carry repair_record_unreadable (and the run ids) for this instance and for an uploaded export JSON, and the Merge panel writes the warning beside the numbers (one string, 12 locales); the merge still runs and refuses nothing. The warning also survives an uploaded all-diagnostics bundle and the panel's own YAML export (a top-level basis key, written only when the record was unreadable; load_overlay ignores it); the command-line merge does not show it. Rule 12 = b, carried out: repair_still_followed now ignores a judging attempt that merged_rows names (a backup merge inserted it), so only a later attempt this install made turns a repaired row measured in the export, the provenance page and the Merge. No migration, no backfill: a repaired row whose newer attempt came through a tracked merge goes from measured back to inherited at its next export. The residue (an imported attempt with no merged_rows row: a batch removed by hand, a full replace-restore) reads as local and is pinned by a test. Each fix has a test that fails when it is removed.
